scope: Primary journal/author or institutional research records checked by browser; DOI/title deduplication against the existing bibliography before insertion. No numerical fits, simulation, or benchmark outcomes added.

added.author: Harris, Ruth A. and Simpson, Robert W.
added.title: Suppression of large earthquakes by stress shadows: A comparison of {Coulomb} and rate-and-state failure
added.journal: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth
added.use: Rate-and-state explanations of quiescence depend on fault state; the apparent exception does not establish a universal shadow rule.

added.author: Parsons, Tom
added.title: Global {Omori} law decay of triggered earthquakes: Large aftershocks outside the classical aftershock zone
added.journal: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth
added.use: Relates global triggered-event decay and computed shear-stress changes; this is the explicitly selected Parsons (2002) paper.

added.author: Felzer, Karen R. and Brodsky, Emily E.
added.title: Decay of aftershock density with distance indicates triggering by dynamic stress
added.use: Interprets an observed spatial decay in terms of dynamic triggering; a competing physical interpretation, not proof of the present statistical kernels.

added.author: Mallman, Ellen P. and Zoback, Mark D.
added.title: Assessing elastic {Coulomb} stress transfer models using seismicity rates in southern {California} and southwestern {Japan}
added.journal: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth
added.use: Found rate increases in resolved regions of both predicted stress signs and did not reliably resolve decreases; distinguishes a negative finding for particular stress models from physical absence.

added.author: Marsan, David and Lenglin{\'e}, Olivier
added.title: Extending earthquakes' reach through cascading
added.use: Infers probabilistic causal links and emphasizes indirect cascades, rather than assigning deterministic immigrant/offspring labels.

added.author: Console, Rodolfo and Murru, Maura
added.title: A simple and testable model for earthquake clustering
added.journal: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth
added.use: A testable occurrence-rate density combines spontaneous activity and triggering from earlier events.

added.author: Helmstetter, Agn{\`e}s and Kagan, Yan Y. and Jackson, David D.
added.title: Comparison of short-term and time-independent earthquake forecast models for southern {California}
added.journal: Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America
added.use: Compares smoothed seismicity and updated triggering forecasts, with different spatial treatment for larger events.

added.author: Werner, Maximilian J. and Helmstetter, Agn{\`e}s and Jackson, David D. and Kagan, Yan Y.
added.title: High-resolution long-term and short-term earthquake forecasts for {California}
added.journal: Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America
added.use: The verified California paper is in BSSA. It proposes forecasts for CSEP, includes magnitude-dependent productivity and uses early aftershocks to represent large-event spatial structure.

added.author: Rhoades, David A. and Schorlemmer, Danijel and Gerstenberger, Matthew C. and Christophersen, Annemarie and Zechar, J. Douglas and Imoto, Masajiro
added.title: Efficient testing of earthquake forecasting models
added.use: Separates consistency tests from paired model comparison; its paired T-test has an explicit normality assumption.

added.author: Woessner, Jochen and Wiemer, Stefan
added.title: Assessing the quality of earthquake catalogues: Estimating the magnitude of completeness and its uncertainty
added.journal: Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America
added.use: Completeness is an estimated observation property with uncertainty, not a consequence of selecting a nominal magnitude threshold.

added.author: Mignan, Arnaud
added.title: Functional shape of the earthquake frequency-magnitude distribution and completeness magnitude
added.journal: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth
added.use: The verified sole-author paper is JGR, distinct from the two-author CORSSA tutorial. It describes a magnitude detection factor and heterogeneous completeness.

added.author: Gardner, J. K. and Knopoff, Leon
added.title: Is the sequence of earthquakes in {Southern California}, with aftershocks removed, {Poissonian}?
added.journal: Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America
added.use: Magnitude-dependent window declustering is a classification procedure; its residual process does not label latent genealogy without assumptions.

added.author: Reasenberg, Paul
added.title: Second-order moment of central {California} seismicity, 1969--1982
added.journal: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth
added.use: Interaction-based aftershock identification allows secondary linkage; it is distinct from probability-weighted stochastic declustering.

added.author: Bray, Andrew and Schoenberg, Frederic Paik
added.title: Assessment of point process models for earthquake forecasting
added.use: Reviews forecast tests and residual alternatives including super-thinning and Voronoi residuals; comparative scoring and adequacy are different questions.

metadata_corrections: WernerEtAl2011 is the California BSSA paper, not a forced attribution to Annals of Geophysics or to a different Werner paper.
RhoadesEtAl2011 is Acta Geophysica 59(4),728--747; the DOI contains s11600, not the truncated s1160 found in an early report.
Mignan2012 here is the sole-author JGR paper. The distinct Mignan--Woessner CORSSA tutorial is not conflated with it.
Parsons2002 is explicitly identified by title and DOI because surname/year alone does not uniquely prescribe a work.
Gardner--Knopoff metadata is checked against the actual scanned paper; the publisher PDF is listed alongside its university-hosted primary-paper copy.

HelmstetterKaganJackson2006 is BSSA 96(1),90--106, not Seismological Research Letters. The distinct high-resolution time-independent grid forecast is the 2007 SRL paper; it is not silently substituted for the requested 2006 comparison.

Mignan2012 was requested with an EPSL journal attribution. A brief search for a 2012 Mignan catalogue-completeness paper in EPSL did not identify such a target. The selected work is explicitly the publisher-verified JGR article Functional shape of the earthquake frequency-magnitude distribution and completeness magnitude, DOI10.1029/2012JB009347.

The related Mignan--Woessner2012 CORSSA tutorial is independently identifiable at DOI10.5078/corssa-00180805 and https://corssa.ethz.ch/export/sites/corssa/.galleries/articles-pdf/Mignan-Woessner-2012-CORSSA-Magnitude-of-completeness.pdf_2063069299.pdf; it is neither EPSL nor the sole-author JGR article.
